name: prayer-times
description: The next Muslim prayer time in Claude Code's status line, a gentle reminder at adhan, and today's timetable in a pane. Calculated on your machine; no network.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Your latitude in degrees (north positive). 0 means: guess from your time zone.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Your longitude in degrees (east positive, west negative). 0 means: guess from your time zone.

place.title: Place name
place.description: What to call your location in the pane, such as Brooklyn. Optional.

method.title: Calculation method
method.description: auto picks the method most used in your time zone's region.

sound.title: At adhan
sound.description: A soft chime, a spoken reminder, or nothing.
